description: Release a bounded batch of contacts off one sequence step and onto another, keeping their existing enrollment. Use this to let the next N contacts waiting on a delay continue early instead of cancelling and re-enrolling them, which discards the enrollment's entry event properties and stop-condition snapshots. Provide sequenceId and fromNodeId; targetNodeId defaults to the source step's only next step. Defaults to dryRun, so pass dryRun false to actually move. Moved contacts become active on the target step immediately, so this sends email as soon as the worker picks them up. limit defaults to 100 and is capped at 500 per call: while remainingCount is above zero, call again to release more. Unlike enroll_subscribers_in_sequence this still works while the sequence has new enrollment paused, because the contacts are already enrolled.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

dailyLimit.description: Guardrail. Refuses to move more than this many enrollments onto targetNodeId in a rolling 24 hours, counting the moves recorded by earlier calls. The response reports movedInWindow and dailyRemaining so a paced release can resume tomorrow.

dryRun.description: When true (the default), reports which enrollments would move without moving them. Pass false to apply.

fromNodeId.description: Node ID the contacts are currently sitting on, such as the delay step they are waiting at. Get it from list_sequence_enrollments (currentNodeId) or get_sequence.

limit.description: Maximum enrollments to move in this call. Defaults to 100, maximum 500.

reason.description: Note stored on every moved enrollment and returned by list_sequence_enrollments as moveReason.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID whose enrollments should be moved.

sort.description: Which enrollments to take first. Defaults to wait_until_asc, meaning the contacts that have been waiting longest for their next step.

subscriberIds.description: Optional narrowing filter: only move these subscribers, up to 500. Omit to take whichever enrollments the sort selects.

tags.description: Tag names applied to the moved contacts so the released wave stays identifiable. The tags must already exist (create_tag). Requires the subscribers:tag scope. Applying them never enrolls contacts in tag_added sequences.

targetNodeId.description: Node ID to move them onto. Defaults to the source step's next step, and is required when that step branches or is terminal. Cannot be the trigger node.

name: move_sequence_enrollments

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `move_sequence_enrollments` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

dailyLimit.description: Applied daily guardrail, or null when none was requested.

dailyRemaining.description: How many more can be moved onto targetNodeId today, or null when no dailyLimit was requested.

dryRun.description: Whether this call only reported the batch instead of moving it.

effectiveLimit.description: How many this call was allowed to move after the daily guardrail was applied.

enqueueErrors.description: Moved enrollments whose queue handoff failed. They stay active on the target step and are recovered by the stuck-enrollment sweeper.

items.description: One tokenId with its enqueue error.

enqueuedCount.description: Moved enrollments handed to the worker queue. Zero while the sequence is not running.

enrollments.description: List of moved (or, on a dry run, would-move) sequence enrollment sample (up to 50) records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

fromNodeId.description: Step the enrollments were taken from.

hasMore.description: Whether more enrollments matched than the returned sample.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

matchedCount.description: Movable enrollments parked on fromNodeId when the request started.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

movedInWindow.description: Moves onto targetNodeId already recorded in the rolling 24-hour window.

remainingCount.description: Movable enrollments still on fromNodeId. Repeat the same request while this is above zero.

skippedCount.description: Enrollments excluded because they are active, a worker is mid-step on them, or they are parked awaiting double opt-in. Only safely parked waiting tokens can be moved.

sort.description: Order the batch was selected in.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

tagResult.description: Tagging outcome for the moved contacts: tags, updated, unchanged, failed, failures. Null when no tags were requested.

targetNodeId.description: Step the enrollments were moved onto, resolved from the source step's next step when not supplied.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
